summary.en: Debugging walk-through: symptom, reproduction, cause, fix, verification.
summary.de: Fehlersuche an Code: Symptom, Reproduktion, Ursache, Fix, Gegenprobe.

audience: Developers who know the language but not this bug
tone: Calm, precise and honest about what was measured versus guessed

structure.purpose: The symptom in one sentence, with the exact error text
How to reproduce it: input, command, expected versus actual
The cause, located in the code: show the faulty lines highlighted
The fix as a diff, line by line
The proof it works: the same reproduction now passes, plus one edge case
What to take away: the root cause class and how to catch it earlier

rules: Show real code from the task; never invent code or error messages.
Use the code template with highlight and groups so each narrated sentence marks its lines.
Separate what was observed from what is assumed; say "I assume" when it is a hypothesis.
Name the root cause, not only the symptom patch.
avoid: Blaming a library or the user without evidence.
Fixes that are not shown to be verified.
